🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 17, 2026

Moon, in Sagittarius, holds a sextile to Mercury, in Libra. Two ways of valuing a thing, meeting at one point: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, falls in Cancer. From Sagittarius, Moon concedes the point early. Fire that starts things, started cheaply. The same angle for two weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Mars in Cancer opens a gap you have to step into. Earth that holds on, holding without strain. Since Venus crossed out of Libra, the question has changed.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Libra, untitled. From Sagittarius, Moon returns your estimate with corrections. Mutable air keeps two accounts open and pays both. Four weeks of Leo ended, and nothing carried over.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, is only passing through Sagittarius. From Libra, Mercury sets a figure against the wanting. Water moves first and pays first. The hold Uranus had a week ago is not there any more.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, untitled in Virgo. Moon trines you from Sagittarius, and the ease asks its own attention. Fixed fire: nothing needs letting go of today. Unchanged for two weeks: you know what it asks.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, moves through Libra unannounced. Moon squares you from Sagittarius, and the cost objects. Mutable earth: every option kept is an option paid for. Pluto let go of it a week ago.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you from Scorpio, the sign that suits it least. Mercury is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Cardinal air: beginning and paying are one act. The trine of three weeks ago is off it now.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you, unsupported in Cancer. Sun sextiles you from Virgo: a door left ajar. Fixed water holds, and holding asks nothing back. The square to Saturn that held a week ago has let go.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. With Moon in your sign, nothing about worth stays abstract. Fire changes shape until there is only one shape. Four weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. From Libra, Mercury cuts across the appetite. Cardinal earth: the beginning has a price on it. A week ago Saturn was still held by Mars; that is finished.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Sagittarius, Moon makes something possible and nothing certain. Air keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon in Sagittarius stands at a right angle: friction, and a clear number. Water that changes shape, charged for each shape. What pressed four weeks ago has cleared.
